metadata.comparison: Same saved input rows, strikes and thresholds. LN/ANN predictions and timings reused from baseline.
metadata.execution: Independent case groups ran concurrently; per-run wall timings include resource contention. Three published-example space runs were reused from earlier in this same turn with the unchanged legacy arithmetic; their original solver hash and missing CPU timing are explicit in each record. All other final runs use fit-enabled source.
metadata.limitation: Pilot-specific settings; time/domain checks use medium spatial grids, not the finest grids.
metadata.timing: Wall seconds include pricing and IV inversion. CPU seconds are recorded where measured; null means unmeasured. Sum of per-case wall times is computational work, not total elapsed time. No full-sample extrapolation.

producer_metadata.timing: Wall and process CPU seconds, including price solve and IV inversion; experiments can overlap independent processes.
